purpose: Compact nearest-neighbour inventory for originality review. It complements, but does not replace, the deep benchmark corpus.

completeness_contract.statement: This inventory is intentionally broader than the deep corpus but is still not guaranteed exhaustive. Absence from this inventory is not evidence that a proposed family is original.
completeness_contract.approval_rule: Passing local deep-corpus and inventory similarity checks is necessary but insufficient. Agent H must also perform external mathematical nearest-neighbour retrieval for every proposed family.

copyright_policy: Store bounded source-independent fingerprints and provenance metadata only. Do not store full question wording, full solution text, transcript text, or source diagrams.

inventory_semantics.confirmed-used: Source explicitly says the family was used in Oxford interview/admissions interviewing.
inventory_semantics.official-sample: University of Oxford publishes it as a sample interview question.
inventory_semantics.official-demonstration: Problem appears in an official demonstration interview.
inventory_semantics.official-preparation-interview-style: First-party Oxford material explicitly frames it as an interview continuation/starter.
inventory_semantics.official-preparation: First-party Oxford admissions/preparation material; useful for collision search but not evidence of interview use.
